title: OpenCode Go infrastructure smoke cohort
description: Six models ran through the OpenCode harness and OpenCode Go subscription across the same three externally verified infrastructure incidents.

changes.failure: OpenCode Go endpoint became unavailable after the agent began work

corrections.reason: The retained OpenCode stderr records repeated upstream endpoint-unavailable errors after six completed model rounds and ten tool calls. The original generic Service Unavailable message did not match Replaybook's provider-interruption classifier.

notes: This is an independent OpenCode/OpenCode Go harness cohort. Its aggregates are not pooled with Claux/OpenRouter results.
All 18 trials used Replaybook commit 1355764, host harness v22, high reasoning, a 900-second deadline, and scenarios 001, 015, and 024 from ducks/replaybook-infra 20260817.1.0.
MiniMax M3 and Qwen3.8 Max completed all three repairs. The other four lanes completed two of three.

DeepSeek, Luna, and Kimi applied the missing database migration in scenario 024 but left the green application instance on the previous release, so the verifier correctly recorded release_not_converged.
OpenCode Go reported subscription usage estimates, but not metered API cost, so public cost remains unavailable rather than zero.
observations: The Discourse interrupted-deploy scenario produced the clearest separation: MiniMax, Qwen, and GLM converged the rollout; DeepSeek, Luna, and Kimi repaired the schema without finishing the green instance rollout.

The cohort demonstrates why harness and provider identity belong in the benchmark boundary. These are complete model-plus-OpenCode results, not interchangeable measurements of the same models through Claux.
reproduction_command: python integrations/host/run_host_matrix.py --scenario-pack ../replaybook-infra --scenario 001-nginx-502-host --scenario 015-sidekiq-poison-pill --scenario 024-discourse-interrupted-deploy --models opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash opencode-go/glm-5.3 opencode-go/gpt-5.6-luna opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code opencode-go/minimax-m3 opencode-go/qwen3.8-max --reasoning-efforts high --attempts 1 --concurrency 2 --agent-adapter integrations/host/adapters/opencode.sh --agent-payload ~/.opencode/bin/opencode --agent-env-file ~/.config/replaybook/opencode.env --agent-name opencode
